text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: (One last night before tryouts...)

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Sorry to make you wait. Just a little longer
now... just a little longer.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Tomorrow, I'm going to win, make my
debut... and then I'll bring back
lots and
lots of victories for you.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: You can count on your big sister, okay?

text_block_list.name: Young Ayabe
text_block_list.text: So it was you?

text_block_list.name: Young Ayabe
text_block_list.text:
The one who wanted to run, who wanted
to win. The one who had so
much fun...
and felt so lonely.

text_block_list.name: Young Ayabe
text_block_list.text: That was all you? Tell me...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Admire Vega's long-awaited tryout race is
about to begin. Trainers
pack the stands,
expectant eyes glued to the track.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm no exception, of course, but at the
same time...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...I'll win. No matter what.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After what I saw that night, I can't help but
feel as concerned as I am
excited.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
All the same, the starting gates fly open,
and the race begins.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooo!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: (I'm going to win... I need to win.)

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
When I looked into it, I found out my
sister and I were truly in a bad
situation.
One of us was definitely not going to make
it.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
My survival was a mere coincidence. Or
maybe... it was a miracle from
my sister.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: And that's why...

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
And now they've rounded the final corner
and come onto the
homestretch! Leading
the way is number nine, with the popular

Admire Vega in fifth!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant... Ngh!

text_block_list.name: Skilled Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Admire Vega's getting boxed in, looks
like. Might be difficult to
position herself
here.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
(No... No! Victory is the only acceptable
outcome! Because I...)

text_block_list.name: Young Ayabe
text_block_list.text:
You... you would've really liked running,
right? You'd want to run and
win, if you
could have your way.

text_block_list.name: Young Ayabe
text_block_list.text: Then... then I'll do it.

text_block_list.name: Young Ayabe
text_block_list.text: I'll make all that happen for you.

text_block_list.name: Young Ayabe
text_block_list.text: Because I'm your big sister!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
(I'm going to keep running, keep winning,
and keep earning her
glory!)

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
(That's why I'm here—the only reason!
That's why I'm alive!)

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Hraaaaghhh!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Cutting in toward the inside and charging
hard is Admire Vega! Now
in third,
second... first! Wh-what an incredible burst
of speed!

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer A
text_block_list.text: Huh? Wait, did she just...

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
And she's done it! First place in the tryout
race goes to Admire Vega!
Admire Vega!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her incredible late rally sends the crowd
into a fever pitch.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
...Which is soon followed by uneasy
murmurs.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant...

text_block_list.name: Tryouts Staff A
text_block_list.text:
This is an announcement regarding the
most recent race. Admire
Vega, due to
interference on the final straight, has been
demoted to
fourth.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Admire Vega runs from the commotion,
without so much as a word to
any trainer.
